title: Product Page Settings (All Products)

fields.label: Add to cart label
fields.name: pdp_add_to_cart_label
fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Discount badge
fields.name: pdp_discount_badge
fields.instructions: {percent} is replaced with the discount: calculated from the regular and sale price next to the price, the plan's discount in the installments box. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Pre-tax price label
fields.name: pdp_pretax_label
fields.instructions: Shown only when taxes are enabled in WooCommerce. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Size selector heading
fields.name: pdp_size_heading
fields.instructions: Shown above the size buttons of variable products with one attribute (with several, each uses its attribute name). The second line of each button is the term's description in Products → Attributes. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Installments box: title
fields.name: pdp_benefits_title
fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Plan 1: payments
fields.name: pdp_plan_1_payments
fields.instructions: Number of payments the price is divided into; 1 is a single payment. Set to 0 to hide this plan. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Plan 1: discount (%)
fields.name: pdp_plan_1_discount
fields.instructions: Taken off the price before dividing it, e.g. 20 on $849 → 6 payments of $113,20. 0 shows no badge. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Plan 2: payments
fields.name: pdp_plan_2_payments
fields.instructions: Number of payments the price is divided into; 1 is a single payment. Set to 0 to hide this plan. Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Installments: "payments" word
fields.name: pdp_installments_label
fields.instructions: Bold after the number, e.g. "12 cuotas". Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Installments: text before the amount
fields.name: pdp_installments_text
fields.instructions: E.g. "sin interés de". Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Single payment: "payment" word
fields.name: pdp_single_label
fields.instructions: Used when a plan has 1 payment, e.g. "1 pago". Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.

fields.label: Single payment: text before the amount
fields.name: pdp_single_text
fields.instructions: E.g. "de". Leave empty to use the default shown in the design.
